items.title: Insani insulin banane ke paanch qadam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of making insulin (PDF 165-166).

items: Do genes ki tayyari: Kyun ke insulin do alag chains se bani hai, scientists do mukhtalif DNA sequences banate hain: aik Chain A ke liye aur aik Chain B ke liye.

Recombinant plasmids banana: Plasmids ke do set liye jate hain. Chain A ka DNA plasmids ke aik set mein aur Chain B ka DNA doosre set mein dala jata hai. Dono soorton mein insulin gene aksar kisi bacterial gene (jaise lacZ) ke saath laga diya jata hai taa ke bacteria is bahar ke DNA ko "pehchan" kar express kar sakein.
Host cells ki transformation: Recombinant plasmids Escherichia coli bacteria ke do alag cultures mein dale jate hain. Culture 1 Chain A banane ki factory ban jata hai aur Culture 2 Chain B ki.

Fermentation aur protein expression: Bacteria bare industrial bioreactors (bari tankiyon) mein ugaye jate hain. Bacteria barhte aur apne aam metabolic kaam karte hue saath saath insaani DNA ko "parhte" hain aur insulin ki alag alag chains bari miqdar mein banate hain.

Nikalna aur chemical jor: Chains ban jane ke baad bacteria jama kiye jate hain aur insulin chains nikal kar saaf (purify) ki jati hain. Laboratory mein Chain A aur Chain B mila di jati hain. Khaas amino acids ke darmiyan di-sulfide bonds (sulfur se sulfur ke pul) bana kar dono ko jora jata hai.

blocks.text: Yeh aakhri qadam kaam karne wala, three-dimensional (teen rukhi) insaani insulin molecule banata hai jo sehatmand insaan ke pancreas ki insulin ke bilkul barabar hota hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar unwaan wale hisse. 1. Do genes ki tayyari: chain A (21 amino acids), chain B (30 amino acids), har chain ka banaya gaya DNA. 2. Recombinant plasmids ki tameer: restriction enzyme plasmid A aur B kaat'ta, DNA ligase recombinant plasmids (chain A) aur (chain B) banata. 3. Host cells ki transformation: chain A aur B ke liye E. coli, chain A aur B ki paidawar, alag ki gayi chain A. 4. Fermentation aur protein ka izhaar: saaf chains, kimiyai jor, aakhri fa'al insani insulin.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.8: Bacteria mein insani insulin ki tayyari (kitab ki Figure 20.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels kitab ke mutabiq: 21/30 amino acids, Restriction enzyme, DNA ligase, E. coli for Chain A/B, Purified polypeptides, Chemical joining, Final active Human insulin.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chain A mein 21 aur Chain B mein 30 amino acids hain. Har chain ka gene alag plasmid mein jata hai, har plasmid alag E. coli culture mein jata hai, aur aakhir mein dono saaf ki hui chains chemical jor se aik active insulin molecule banati hain.

blocks.prompt: Chain A aur Chain B do alag cultures mein kyun banayi jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Har culture mein sirf aik chain ke gene wale plasmids hote hain, is liye woh sirf wahi chain bari miqdar mein banata hai. Saaf ki hui dono chains phir laboratory mein di-sulfide bonds se jori jati hain.

items: Chain A aur Chain B ke liye do DNA sequences banaye jate hain.
Har DNA plasmids ke alag set mein (aksar lacZ ke saath) aur phir E. coli ke alag culture mein jata hai.
Bioreactors mein bacteria chains banate hain; chains nikal kar saaf ki jati hain aur di-sulfide bonds se jori jati hain.
